findings.claim: TTM 10-K 披露約 50% 淨銷售來自非美國營運，大量製造材料來自國際供應商；美中兩國均已將 PCB 列入進口關稅項目，可能影響營收與獲利。
findings.excerpt: Both the U.S. and Chinese governments have included PCBs among items subjected to tariffs imposed on imports from such countries, which may negatively impact our revenue and profitability.

findings.claim: TTM 部分產品受美國商務部 BIS 依 EAR 管制出口，並須遵守 ITAR/EAR 與制裁法規；違規可能被罰款或喪失出口權限。
findings.excerpt: Some items we manufacture are controlled for export by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security under EAR.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋僅一次，未找到 TTM 專屬 Section 232 資訊；2026-01 半導體 232 關稅未見涵蓋裸 PCB（二手評論，未採為 finding）。
